items: ZIP export is more reliable: it retries what fails and tells you which files it could not include.
In virtual reality each scene's arrival view is respected, and gates work there too.
The browser address no longer overrides a scene's initial view.
Properties start collapsed, so the panel is easier to scan.
The Mute button is always visible.
Direct access to the Floor plan.
Team is in the sidebar, and each project can be shared with specific people.
A logo of its own for each tour.
The badge text can be changed.
The guided tour opens the same panels as clicking each hotspot.
New “Action (variables)” hotspot with a visual condition editor.
